items.difficulty_reason: 68 行、四步：①fully faithful 已由 relative-descend-homomorphisms 给出 ⇒ 只需本质满；②并集步：局部取 S_i-perfect 原像，伴随映射 a、b 落在 Rf_{i,*}E 的限制上，fully faithful 增大 i 后取重叠上的相容同构 c，用 cohomology-lemma-glue 拼出 E_i（相对 perfect 是局部性质）且 d 伴随到同构；③induction principle 两段归约到 X_0、S_0 仿射；④仿射情形由 more-algebra-lemma-colimit-relatively-perfect 收尾（翻译由 affine-locally-rel-perfect 完成）。承重的粘合构造与归约链都在 span 内；6 处引用（3 同章、3 跨章）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-descend-relatively-perfect (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 9118-9123

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the reduction to essential surjectivity by the already established fully faithfulness, the gluing of local preimages over a union of opens through the adjoint maps and the glue lemma, the reduction to the affine case by the induction principle, and the final algebraic input on colimits of relatively perfect modules (source lines 9125-9185)
